Pi =: 3.141592653589793
rot =: 3 : '(2 o.y)j.-(1 o.y)'
pow2 =: 3 : 0
    result =. 1

        result =. 2*result

radix2 =: 4 : 0
    inverse =. x
    values =. 0j0+y
    count =. #values
    bits =. 0
    power =. count
    while. power>1 do.
        bits =. bits+1
        power =. <.power%2
    end.
    for_index. 1+i.count-1 do.
        reversed =. 0
        rest =. index
        for_bit. i.bits do.
            reversed =. (2*reversed)+2|rest
            rest =. <.rest%2
        end.
        if. index<reversed do.
            temporary =. index{values
            values =. (reversed{values)index}values
            values =. temporary reversed}values
        end.
    end.
    twiddle =. rot (((2.0*Pi)*i.<.count%2)%count)
    if. inverse do.
        twiddle =. +twiddle
    end.
    size =. 2
    while. size<:count do.
        stride =. <.count%size
        half =. <.size%2
        for_start. size*i.<.count%size do.
            for_j. i.half do.
                t =. ((j*stride){twiddle)*(start+j+half){values
                u =. (start+j){values
                values =. (u+t)(start+j)}values
                values =. (u-t)(start+j+half)}values
            end.
        end.
        size =. 2*size
    end.
    if. inverse do.
        values =. values%count
    end.
    values
)
bluestein =: 3 : 0
    count =. #y
    size =. pow2 (2*count)-1
    indices =. i.count
    chirp =. rot (Pi*((2*count)|indices*indices))%count
    a =. size$0j0
    b =. a
    for_k. i.count do.
        a =. ((k{y)*k{chirp)k}a
        b =. (+k{chirp)k}b
        if. k do.
            b =. (k{b)(size-k)}b
        end.
    end.
    product =. (0 radix2 a)*0 radix2 b
    convolution =. 1 radix2 product
    chirp*count{.convolution
)
dft =: 3 : 0
    if. (#y)=pow2 #y do.
        0 radix2 y
    else.
        bluestein y
    end.
)
idft =: 3 : 0
    if. (#y)=pow2 #y do.
        1 radix2 y
    else.
        (+bluestein +y)%#y
    end.
)
packed_real =: 3 : 0
    count =. #y
    half =. <.count%2
    even =. 2*i.half
    z =. (even{y)j.(even+1){y
    transformed =. 0 radix2 z
    result =. 0$0j0
    for_k. i.half+1 do.
        a =. (half|k){transformed
        b =. +(half|half-k){transformed
        e =. (a+b)%2.0
        o =. (a-b)%0j2
        result =. result,e+(rot ((2.0*Pi)*k)%count)*o
    end.
    result
)
convolution =: 4 : 0
    count =. (#x)+(#y)-1
    size =. pow2 count
    transformed =. (0 radix2 size{.x)*0 radix2 size{.y
    count{.9 o.1 radix2 transformed

chirp_z =: 4 : 0
    'sample_rate low high points' =. x
    count =. #y
    step =. (high-low)%(points-1)
    size =. pow2 count+points-1
    a =. size$0j0
    b =. a
    for_n. i.count do.
        first =. rot ((((2.0*Pi)*low)*n)%sample_rate)
        second =. rot (((Pi*step)*n)*n)%sample_rate
        a =. (((n{y)*first)*second)n}a
    end.
    for_offset. (1-count)+i.count+points-1 do.
        value =. +rot ((((Pi*step)*offset)*offset)%sample_rate)
        b =. value (size|offset)}b
    end.
    product =. (0 radix2 a)*0 radix2 b
    g =. 1 radix2 product
    result =. 0$0j0
    for_j. i.points do.
        result =. result,(rot ((((Pi*step)*j)*j)%sample_rate))*j{g
    end.
    result
)

strongest =: 4 : 0
    indices =. i.0
    for_j. 1+i.(#y)-2 do.
        if. y local_maximum j do.

detrend =: 4 : 0
    sample_rate =. x
    count =. #y
    average =. (total y)%count
    center =. (count-1)%2.0
    numerator =. 0.0
    denominator =. 0.0
    for_i. i.count do.
        offset =. i-center
        numerator =. numerator+offset*(i{y)-average
        denominator =. denominator+offset*offset
    end.
    slope =. numerator%denominator
    residual =. i.0
    peak =. 0.0
    third =. 0.0
    fourth =. 0.0
    for_i. i.count do.
        value =. ((i{y)-average)-slope*(i-center)
        residual =. residual,value
        peak =. peak>.|value
        third =. third+value^3
        fourth =. fourth+value^4
    end.
    level =. rms residual
    statistics =. average,(slope*sample_rate),level,(<./y),(>./y),(peak%level),((third%count)%level^3),(fourth%count)%level^4
    (<residual),<statistics
)
bandwidth =: 4 : 0
    index =. x
    cutoff =. (index{y)%%:2.0
    left =. 0.0
    right =. 0.0+(#y)-1
    for_j. (index+1)+i.(#y)-(index+1) do.
        if. (j{y)<:cutoff do.
            right =. (j-1)+(((j-1){y)-cutoff)%((j-1){y)-j{y
            break.
        end.
    end.
    for_j. |.i.index do.
        if. (j{y)<:cutoff do.
            left =. (j+1)-(((j+1){y)-cutoff)%((j+1){y)-j{y
            break.
        end.
    end.
    right-left
)
target_index =: 4 : 0
    'length center width' =. x
    best =. _1
    for_k. 1+i.(<.length%2)-1 do.
        if. (|k-center)<:width do.
            if. best<0 do.
                best =. k
            elseif. (k{y)>best{y do.
                best =. k
            end.
        end.
    end.
    best
)
analyze_peaks =: 3 : 0
    MaximumAmplitude =: >./Amplitudes
    NoiseFloor =: median }.}:Amplitudes
    PeakBins =: i.0
    PeakData =: 0 9$0.0
    for_k. (#Amplitudes)strongest Amplitudes do.
        if. ((decibels (k{Amplitudes)%MaximumAmplitude)<PeakThreshold)+.(#PeakBins)>:PeakCount do.
            continue.
        end.
        'position amplitude' =. (k,1)interpolate Amplitudes
        coherence_bin =. ((2*k*WelchLength)+MainLength)intdiv 2*MainLength
        row =. position,amplitude,((k*Fs)%MainLength),((position*Fs)%MainLength),(decibels (k{Amplitudes)%MaximumAmplitude),(phase k{Transformed),(((k bandwidth Amplitudes)*Fs)%MainLength),(decibels (k{Amplitudes)%NoiseFloor),coherence_bin{2{::Welch
        PeakBins =: PeakBins,k
        PeakData =: PeakData,row
    end.
    PeakLabels =: (#PeakBins)$<'other'
    for_index. i.#PeakBins do.
        k =. index{PeakBins
        position =. (<index,0){PeakData
        label =. 'other'
        for_h. 1+i.10 do.
            target =. ((h*Fundamental)*MainLength)%Fs
            if. (|position-target)<:SearchWidth do.
                label =. 'h',integer h
                break.
            end.
        end.
        if. label-:'other' do.
            frequency =. (position*Fs)%MainLength
            multiple =. <.0.5+frequency%NotchFrequency
            if. (multiple>:1)*.(|frequency-multiple*NotchFrequency)<:NotchWidth do.
                label =. 'mains'
            end.
        end.
        if. label-:'other' do.
            for_pivot. i.#PeakBins do.
                kp =. pivot{PeakBins
                if. (kp=k)+.(kp{Amplitudes)<:k{Amplitudes do.
                    continue.
                end.
                for_other. i.#PeakBins do.
                    kr =. other{PeakBins
                    if. (kr=k)+.kr=kp do.
                        continue.
                    end.
                    if. ((kp{Amplitudes)>kr{Amplitudes)*.(|((position+(<other,0){PeakData)-2.0*(<pivot,0){PeakData))<:1.0 do.
                        label =. 'sideband',integer pivot+1
                        break.
                    end.
                end.
                if. -.label-:'other' do.
                    break.
                end.
            end.
        end.
        PeakLabels =: (<label)index}PeakLabels
    end.
    i.0
)
analyze_filters =: 3 : 0
    count =. #X
    transformed =. dft X
    band =. count$0j0
    notch =. band
    analytic_spectrum =. band
    kept =. 0
    removed =. 0
    for_k. i.count do.
        frequency =. (k<.count-k)*Fs
        if. ((BandLow*count)<:frequency)*.frequency<:BandHigh*count do.
            band =. (k{transformed)k}band
            kept =. kept+1
        end.
        multiple =. ((2*frequency)+NotchFrequency*count)intdiv 2*NotchFrequency*count
        if. (multiple>:1)*.(|frequency-(multiple*NotchFrequency)*count)<:NotchWidth*count do.
            removed =. removed+1
        else.
            notch =. (k{transformed)k}notch
        end.
        if. (k>:1)*.(k<:<.(count-1)%2)*.((EnvelopeLow*count)<:k*Fs)*.(k*Fs)<:EnvelopeHigh*count do.
            analytic_spectrum =. (2.0*k{transformed)k}analytic_spectrum
        end.
    end.
    bandpassed =. 9 o.idft band
    notched =. 9 o.idft notch
    analytic =. idft analytic_spectrum
    envelope =. |analytic
    envelope_mean =. (total envelope)%count
    modulation =. (2.0*|dft envelope-envelope_mean)%count
    stop =. ((EnvelopeHigh-EnvelopeLow)*count)intdiv 2*Fs
    envelope_bin =. (1,stop)maximum_index modulation
    'position amplitude' =. (envelope_bin,1)interpolate modulation
    instantaneous =. i.0
    for_i. 1+i.count-1 do.
        delta =. (12 o.i{analytic)-12 o.(i-1){analytic
        if. delta<:-Pi do.
            delta =. delta+2.0*Pi
        end.
        if. delta>Pi do.
            delta =. delta-2.0*Pi
        end.
        instantaneous =. instantaneous,(delta*Fs)%2.0*Pi
    end.
    frequency_mean =. (total instantaneous)%#instantaneous
    variance =. 0.0
    for_value. instantaneous do.
        variance =. variance+(value-frequency_mean)^2
    end.
    smoothed =. Y convolution Fir
    gain =. 0j0
    for_j. i.#Fir do.
        angle =. (((2.0*Pi)*Fundamental)*j)%Fs
        gain =. gain+(j{Fir)*rot angle
    end.
    fir_error =. 0.0
    for_i. i.count+(#Fir)-1 do.
        direct =. 0.0
        low =. 0>.i-((#Fir)-1)
        high =. (count-1)<.i
        for_j. low+i.1+high-low do.
            direct =. direct+(j{Y)*(i-j){Fir
        end.
        fir_error =. fir_error>.|(i{smoothed)-direct
    end.
    metrics =. (rms bandpassed),(rms notched),((energy bandpassed)%energy X),(total Fir),(decibels |gain),(rms count{.smoothed),fir_error,envelope_mean,((position*Fs)%count),amplitude,(amplitude%envelope_mean),frequency_mean,%:variance%#instantaneous
    FilterResult =: (<bandpassed),(<notched),(<envelope),(<smoothed),(<metrics),<kept,removed,envelope_bin
    i.0
)
